FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-001.says: The settings as they start: Uniform, Lightness 10, speed 1: each shown pixel's lightness moves up to 0.1 either way, a whole new noise every frame; the covering kept and the empty pixels left.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-002.says: Speed 0: the noise holds still, every frame Noise HLS's at phase 0 (FX-NOISEHLS-001).

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-003.says: Speed 0.5, Lightness 30: frame 1 is half way from the first noise to the next, Noise HLS's phase 180 (FX-NOISEHLS-010); frame 2 is the next noise.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-004.says: Hue 50, Lightness 0: each coloured pixel's hue turns up to 90 degrees either way, differently each frame; the grey has no hue and is left.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-006.says: Squared, Lightness 30: the noise pushed out towards its ends.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-007.says: Grain, Grain Size 4, Lightness 30, speed 0.25: soft cells four pixels across, a new grain every four frames, gliding between.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-008.says: Grain, Grain Size 2.5, Hue 40, Saturation 40, Lightness 0, speed 2: two new grains a frame.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-009.says: Hue, Lightness and Saturation 0: the drawing, untouched, on every frame.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-010.says: Hue, Lightness and Saturation 30 moved three pixels right: the noise is the drawing's own, so it moves with it.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-011.says: Hue, Lightness and Saturation 30 after a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the noise is worked in the drawing's own pixels.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-012.says: Lightness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4: frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-013.says: Speed keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, Lightness 30: the speed at the frame times the frame, so frame 2 is speed 1's frame 2 and frame 4 is depth 8.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-014.says: Grain, Grain Size 0.5, Lightness 30: cells of half a pixel.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-015.says: Grain, Grain Size 3, Hue 20, Lightness 25, Saturation 60, speed 0.75: the controls together.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-016.says: Hue 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-017.says: Lightness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-018.says: Saturation 150, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-019.says: Grain Size 0.25, below 0.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-020.says: Speed 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-021.says: Speed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-022.says: Noise "Squared", in capitals, kept as written and not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-023.says: Noise "film", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLSAUTO-024.says: Saturation keyed to 120 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
